$E (\widehat {\sigma^ {2}}) = \frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E Z _ {i} = \frac {1}{2 n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} 2 \sigma^ {2} = \frac {1}{2 n} \cdot 2 \sigma^ {2} \cdot n = \sigma^ {2}.$

【注】由

$f (x, y) = \frac {1}{2 \pi \sigma^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}} = \frac {1}{2 \pi \sigma \cdot \sigma \cdot \sqrt {1 - 0 ^ {2}}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{2 (1 - 0 ^ {2})} \left[ \frac {(x - 0) ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} - 2 \times 0 \times \frac {(x - 0) (y - 0)}{\sigma \cdot \sigma} + \frac {(y - 0) ^ {2}}{\sigma^ {2}} \right]},$

知 $(X,Y)\sim N(0,0;\sigma^{2},\sigma^{2};0)$ ， $\rho_{XY}=0$ ，从而X与Y相互独立， $X^{2}$ 与 $Y^{2}$ 也相互独立， $X\sim N(0,\sigma^{2})$ ， $Y\sim N(0,\sigma^{2})$ ，且 $\left(\frac{X-0}{\sigma}\right)^{2}\sim\chi^{2}(1),\left(\frac{Y-0}{\sigma}\right)^{2}\sim\chi^{2}(1)$ ，所以，

$\frac {1}{\sigma^ {2}} (X ^ {2} + Y ^ {2}) \sim \chi^ {2} (2).$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
题目内容:
设 T 是连续型随机变量， $P\{T \leqslant a\} = \theta,\quad P\{T > b\} = \theta$ ，其中 $\theta \in \left(0, \frac{1}{2}\right)$ ，$a < b$。令
$$X = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - 1, & T \leqslant a, \\ 1, & T > a, \end{array} \right. \quad Y = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} - 1, & T \leqslant b, \\ 1, & T > b. \end{array} \right.$$
(I) 求 $(X,Y)$ 的概率分布及 $Z=X+Y$ 的概率分布;
(II) 若 $\theta$ 为未知参数, 则利用总体 $Z$ 的样本值 $-2,0,0,0,2,2$ 求 $\theta$ 的矩估计值与最大似然估计值.
解析:
解 (I) 由 $P\{T > b\} = \theta$ , 知 $P\{T \leqslant b\} = 1 - \theta$ ,

$P \{X = - 1, Y = - 1 \} = P \{T \leqslant a, T \leqslant b \} = P \{T \leqslant a \} = \theta ,$

$P \{X = - 1, Y = 1 \} = P \{T \leqslant a, T > b \} = 0,$

$P \{X = 1, Y = - 1 \} = P \{T > a, T \leqslant b \} = P \{a < T \leqslant b \} = 1 - 2 \theta ,$

$P \{X = 1, Y = 1 \} = 1 - \theta - 0 - (1 - 2 \theta) = \theta ,$

故 $(X,Y)$ 的概率分布为

![Image](images/80372302.jpg)

$Z = X + Y$ 的取值为 $-2,0,2$ ，且

$\begin{array}{c} P \{Z = - 2 \} = P \{X + Y = - 2 \} = P \{X = - 1, Y = - 1 \} = \theta , \\ P \{Z = 0 \} = P \{X + Y = 0 \} = P \{X = 1, Y = - 1 \} + P \{X = - 1, Y = 1 \} \\ = 1 - 2 \theta + 0 = 1 - 2 \theta , \\ P \{Z = 2 \} = 1 - \theta - (1 - 2 \theta) = \theta , \end{array}$

故 $Z$ 的概率分布为

$\begin{array}{c c c c} Z & - 2 & 0 & 2 \\ \hline P & \theta & 1 - 2 \theta & \theta \end{array}$

(Ⅱ) 由(Ⅰ)知, EZ = 0, 且

$E (Z ^ {2}) = (- 2) ^ {2} \cdot \theta + 0 ^ {2} \cdot (1 - 2 \theta) + 2 ^ {2} \cdot \theta = 8 \theta ,$

故

$8 \theta = \frac {1}{6} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {6} Z _ {i} ^ {2} = \frac {(- 2) ^ {2} + 0 ^ {2} + 0 ^ {2} + 0 ^ {2} + 2 ^ {2} + 2 ^ {2}}{6} = 2,$

得 $\theta$ 的矩估计值为 $\hat{\theta} = \frac{1}{4}$ .

似然函数为

$L (\theta) = \theta \cdot (1 - 2 \theta) ^ {3} \cdot \theta^ {2} = \theta^ {3} (1 - 2 \theta) ^ {3},$

两边取对数,得

$\ln L (\theta) = 3 \ln \theta + 3 \ln (1 - 2 \theta).$

令

$\frac{d}{d\theta}\ln L(\theta)=\frac{3}{\theta}-\frac{6}{1-2\theta}=\frac{3-12\theta}{\theta(1-2\theta)}=0,$ 得 $\theta$ 的最大似然估计值为 $\hat{\theta}=\frac{1}{4}.$

【注】在(Ⅱ)中,由于一阶矩 EZ = 0, 故用二阶矩 $E(Z^{2})$ 计算 $\theta$ 的矩估计值.

章节: 第七章 参数估计
解析:
解 (I) Z 的分布函数为

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Z} (z) & = P \{X Y \leqslant z \} = P \{X Y \leqslant z, Y = - 1 \} + P \{X Y \leqslant z, Y = 1 \} \\ & = P \{Y = - 1 \} P \{X \geqslant - z \} + P \{Y = 1 \} P \{X \leqslant z \} \\ & = \frac {1}{2} (1 - P \{X < - z \}) + \frac {1}{2} P \{X \leqslant z \} \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \left[ 1 - \Phi \left(- \frac {z}{\sigma}\right) \right] + \frac {1}{2} \Phi \left(\frac {z}{\sigma}\right) = \Phi \left(\frac {z}{\sigma}\right), \end{array}$

其中 $\Phi(x)$ 为 $N(0,1)$ 的分布函数, 故

$f _ {Z} (z) = F _ {Z} ^ {\prime} (z) = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi} \sigma} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}}, z \in (- \infty , + \infty).$

(Ⅱ) 似然函数为

$L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} f _ {Z} (z _ {i}) = (2 \pi) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \cdot (\sigma^ {2}) ^ {- \frac {n}{2}} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + z _ {n} ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}},$

两边取对数,得

$\ln L \left(\sigma^ {2}\right) = - \frac {n}{2} \ln (2 \pi) - \frac {n}{2} \ln \sigma^ {2} - \frac {z _ {1} ^ {2} + z _ {2} ^ {2} + \cdots + z _ {n} ^ {2}}{2 \sigma^ {2}}.$

令 $\frac{d}{d\sigma^{2}}\ln L(\sigma^{2})=-\frac{n}{2\sigma^{2}}+\frac{z_{1}^{2}+z_{2}^{2}+\cdots+z_{n}^{2}}{2(\sigma^{2})^{2}}=0$ ，解得 $\sigma^{2}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}z_{i}^{2}$ ，故 $\sigma^{2}$ 的最大似然估计量为

$\widehat {\sigma^ {2}} = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} Z _ {i} ^ {2}.$

（Ⅲ）由 $Z_{1}, Z_{2}, \cdots, Z_{n}$ 相互独立，且均服从 $N(0, \sigma^{2})$ ，知

$D U = a _ {1} ^ {2} D Z _ {1} + a _ {2} ^ {2} D Z _ {2} + \dots + a _ {n} ^ {2} D Z _ {n} = \sigma^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} ^ {2}.$

应用拉格朗日乘数法，令 $F = \sigma^2\sum_{i = 1}^{n}a_i^2 -\lambda \left(\sum_{i = 1}^{n}a_i - 1\right)$ ，则

$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial F}{\partial a _ {i}} = 2 a _ {i} \sigma^ {2} - \lambda = 0, \\ \frac {\partial F}{\partial \lambda} = - \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} - 1\right) = 0, \end{array} \right.$

解得 $a_{i} = \frac{\lambda}{2\sigma^{2}}$ ，代入 $\sum_{i = 1}^{n}a_{i} = 1$ ，有

$\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {\lambda}{2 \sigma^ {2}} = \frac {\lambda}{2 \sigma^ {2}} \cdot n = 1.$

故 $\lambda = \frac{2\sigma^2}{n}$ , 所以 $a_i = \frac{\lambda}{2\sigma^2} = \frac{\frac{2\sigma^2}{n}}{2\sigma^2} = \frac{1}{n}$ .

于是 $DU$ 的最小值为

$\sigma^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} ^ {2} = \sigma^ {2} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(\frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {2} = \sigma^ {2} \cdot \left(\frac {1}{n}\right) ^ {2} \cdot n = \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n}.$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
解析:
解 (I) 当 $x \leqslant 0$ 时, $f_{X}(x) = 0$ ;

当 $x > 0$ 时，

$\begin{array}{r l} f _ {X} (x) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {2}{\theta^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2 x + y}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} y = \frac {2}{\theta^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2 x}{\theta}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {y}{\theta}} \mathrm{d} y \\ & = \frac {2}{\theta^ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2 x}{\theta}} (- \theta) \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {y}{\theta}} \Bigg | _ {0} ^ {+ \infty} = \frac {2}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2}{\theta} x}, \end{array}$

故

$f _ {X} (x) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2}{\theta} x}, & x > 0, \\ 0, & x \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$

同理可求得

$f _ {Y} (y) = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} f (x, y) \mathrm{d} x = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {1}{\theta} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\theta} y}, & y > 0, \\ 0, & y \leqslant 0. \end{array} \right.$

（Ⅱ）由（Ⅰ）知， $f_{X}(x)\cdot f_{Y}(y)=f(x,y)$ ，故X与Y相互独立，且X服从参数为 $\frac{2}{\theta}$ 的指数分布，Y服从参数为 $\frac{1}{\theta}$ 的指数分布。记 $Z=\min(X,Y)$ ，则Z的分布函数为

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Z} (z) & = P \{\min (X, Y) \leqslant z \} = 1 - P \{\min (X, Y) > z \} \\ & = 1 - P \{X > z, Y > z \} = 1 - P \{X > z \} \cdot P \{Y > z \} \\ & = 1 - [ 1 - P \{X \leqslant z \} ] [ 1 - P \{Y \leqslant z \} ] \\ & = 1 - [ 1 - F _ {X} (z) ] [ 1 - F _ {Y} (z) ] \\ & = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - e ^ {- \frac {3}{\theta} z}, & z > 0, \\ 0, & z \leqslant 0, \end{array} \right. \end{array}$

即 $Z = \min (X,Y)$ 服从参数为 $\frac{3}{\theta}$ 的指数分布.故

$E \left[ \min (X, Y) \right] = \frac {1}{\frac {3}{\theta}} = \frac {\theta}{3}.$

(Ⅲ) $\theta$ 的似然函数为

$\begin{array}{r l} L (\theta) & = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left(\frac {2}{\theta}\right) ^ {n} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {2}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i}} \cdot \left(\frac {1}{\theta}\right) ^ {m} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} y _ {i}}, & x _ {i} > 0, y _ {i} > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其他} \end{array} \right. \\ & = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2 ^ {n}}{\theta^ {n + m}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \left(\frac {2}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} + \frac {1}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} y _ {i}\right)}, & x _ {i} > 0, y _ {i} > 0, \\ 0, & \text {其他}, \end{array} \right. \end{array}$

取对数,得

$\ln L (\theta) = n \ln 2 - (n + m) \ln \theta - \left(\frac {2}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} x _ {i} + \frac {1}{\theta} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} y _ {i}\right).$

令 $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}\theta}\ln L(\theta) = -\frac{n + m}{\theta} +\frac{2}{\theta^2}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}x_i + \frac{1}{\theta^2}\sum_{i = 1}^{m}y_i = 0$ ，解得 $\theta = \frac{2\sum_{i = 1}^{n}x_i + \sum_{i = 1}^{m}y_i}{n + m}$ 故 $\theta$ 的最大似然估计

量为

$\hat {\theta} = \frac {2 \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} X _ {i} + \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} Y _ {i}}{n + m}.$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
解析:
解 (I) 当 $\lambda_{1}$ 已知时,

$\begin{array}{r l} E X & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot f (x; \lambda_ {1}, \lambda_ {2}) \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \int_ {\lambda_ {1}} ^ {+ \infty} x \cdot \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x - \lambda_ {1}}{\lambda_ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \end{array}$

$\frac {x = \lambda_ {1} + \lambda_ {2} y}{\int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (\lambda_ {2} y + \lambda_ {1}) e ^ {- y} d y = \lambda_ {1} + \lambda_ {2}},$

用 $\overline{X}$ 替换EX,得 $\lambda_{2}$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\lambda}_{2}=\overline{X}-\lambda_{1}$ .

关于 $\lambda_{2}$ 的似然函数为

$L \left(\lambda_ {2}\right) = \prod_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x _ {i} - \lambda_ {1}}{\lambda_ {2}}} = \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2} ^ {n}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \frac {x _ {i} - \lambda_ {1}}{\lambda_ {2}}}, \quad \lambda_ {1} \leqslant x _ {1}, x _ {2}, \dots , x _ {n},$

由

$\frac {\mathrm{d} \ln L (\lambda_ {2})}{\mathrm{d} \lambda_ {2}} = - \frac {n}{\lambda_ {2}} + \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2} ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - \lambda_ {1}) = 0,$

解得 $\hat{\lambda}_2 = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}(X_i - \lambda_1)$ 是 $\lambda_{2}$ 的最大似然估计量.

(Ⅱ) $EX = \lambda_{1} + \lambda_{2}$ ,

$\begin{array}{r l} E (X ^ {2}) & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot f (x) \mathrm{d} x = \int_ {\lambda_ {1}} ^ {+ \infty} x ^ {2} \cdot \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {x - \lambda_ {1}}{\lambda_ {2}}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & \xlongequal {x = \lambda_ {1} + \lambda_ {2} y} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} (\lambda_ {2} y + \lambda_ {1}) ^ {2} \mathrm{e} ^ {- y} \mathrm{d} y = 2 \lambda_ {2} ^ {2} + 2 \lambda_ {1} \lambda_ {2} + \lambda_ {1} ^ {2}, \end{array}$

则 $DX = E(X^2) - (EX)^2 = \lambda_2^2.$ 令

$E X = \overline {{{X}}}, D X = \frac {n - 1}{n} S ^ {2} \left(S ^ {2} = \frac {1}{n - 1} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (X _ {i} - \overline {{{X}}}) ^ {2} \text {为样本方差}\right),$

故 $\left\{\begin{aligned}\lambda_{1}+\lambda_{2}&=\overline{X},\\ \lambda_{2}^{2}&=\frac{n-1}{n}S^{2},\end{aligned}\right.$ 所以 $\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$ 的矩估计量为

$\hat {\lambda} _ {1} = \overline {{{X}}} - \sqrt {\frac {n - 1}{n} S ^ {2}}, \quad \hat {\lambda} _ {2} = \sqrt {\frac {n - 1}{n} S ^ {2}}.$

关于 $\lambda_1, \lambda_2$ 的似然函数为

$L (\lambda_ {1}, \lambda_ {2}) = \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2} ^ {n}} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - \lambda_ {1})}, \quad \lambda_ {1} \leqslant x _ {1}, x _ {2}, \dots , x _ {n},$

取对数,求偏导数,得

$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} \frac {\partial \ln L (\lambda_ {1} , \lambda_ {2})}{\partial \lambda_ {1}} = \frac {n}{\lambda_ {2}} = 0, \\ \frac {\partial \ln L (\lambda_ {1} , \lambda_ {2})}{\partial \lambda_ {2}} = - \frac {n}{\lambda_ {2}} + \frac {1}{\lambda_ {2} ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} (x _ {i} - \lambda_ {1}) = 0, \end{array} \right.①$

②

由式 ② 得 $\lambda_{2} = \overline{x} - \lambda_{1}$ . 式 ① 无解, 用最大似然估计原理求 $\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$ 的最大似然估计量.

由 $L(\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2})$ 的表达式知，当 $\hat{\lambda}_{1}$ 使 $L(\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2})>0$ 且使 $\sum_{i=1}^{n}(x_{i}-\lambda_{1})$ 达到最小时，才能使 $L(\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2})$ 达到最大.

当 $x_{i} \geqslant \lambda_{1} (i = 1, 2, \cdots, n)$ ，即 $\min\{X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\} \geqslant \lambda_{1}$ 时，有 $L(\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}) > 0$ ，若使 $\sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_{i} - \lambda_{1})$ 在 $\hat{\lambda}_{1}$ 处达到最小，应取 $\hat{\lambda}_{1} = \min\{X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\}$ ，故当 $\hat{\lambda}_{1} = \min\{X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}\}$ 时，有 $L(\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}) \leqslant L(\hat{\lambda}_{1}, \lambda_{2})$ .

当 $\lambda_{1} = \hat{\lambda}_{1}$ 时，由式②，知 $\hat{\lambda}_2 = \overline{x} -\hat{\lambda}_1$ ，由于 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}\frac{\partial\ln L(\hat{\lambda}_1,\lambda_2)}{\partial\lambda_2} = 0,\\ \frac{\partial^2\ln L(\hat{\lambda}_1,\lambda_2)}{\partial\lambda_2^2} < 0, \end{array} \right.$ 故 $L(\hat{\lambda}_1,\lambda_2)$ 在 $\lambda_{2} = \hat{\lambda}_{2}$ 处达到最大，故有 $L(\hat{\lambda}_1,\lambda_2)\leqslant L(\hat{\lambda}_1,\hat{\lambda}_2)$ ，从而知 $\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2}$ 的最大似然估计量为

$\hat {\lambda} _ {1} = \min \left\{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n} \right\}, \quad \hat {\lambda} _ {2} = \overline {{{X}}} - \min \left\{X _ {1}, X _ {2}, \dots , X _ {n} \right\}.$

章节: 第七章 参数估计
解析:
解（I）用定义法求 $f_{Y_{1}}(y)$ .

当 $y \geqslant 0$ 时，

$\begin{array}{r l} F _ {Y _ {1}} (y) & = P \{Y _ {1} \leqslant y \} = P \{| X _ {1} - \mu | \leqslant y \} \\ & = P \{- y \leqslant X _ {1} - \mu \leqslant y \} = P \left\{- \frac {y}{\sigma} \leqslant \frac {X _ {1} - \mu}{\sigma} \leqslant \frac {y}{\sigma} \right\} \\ & = \Phi \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right) - \Phi \left(- \frac {y}{\sigma}\right) = 2 \Phi \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right) - 1; \end{array}$

当 $y < 0$ 时， $F_{Y_1}(y) = 0$ ，故

$f _ {Y _ {1}} (y) = F _ {Y _ {1}} ^ {\prime} (y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {2}{\sigma} \varphi \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right), & y \geqslant 0, \\ 0, & y < 0, \end{array} \right.$

其中 $\Phi(x)$ 为 $N(0,1)$ 的分布函数， $\varphi(x)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\mathrm{e}^{-\frac{x^{2}}{2}},-\infty$

(Ⅱ)

$\begin{array}{r l} E Y _ {1} & = \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} y f _ {Y _ {1}} (y) \mathrm{d} y = \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {2 y}{\sigma} \varphi \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right) \mathrm{d} y \\ & = 2 \sigma \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \frac {y}{\sigma} \varphi \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right) \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {y}{\sigma}\right) \\ & \xlongequal {\frac {y}{\sigma} = t} 2 \sigma \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \varphi (t) \mathrm{d} t = 2 \sigma \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} t \cdot \frac {1}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \cdot \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm{d} t \\ & = \frac {2 \sigma}{\sqrt {2 \pi}} \int_ {0} ^ {+ \infty} \mathrm{e} ^ {- \frac {t ^ {2}}{2}} \mathrm{d} \left(\frac {t ^ {2}}{2}\right) = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma , \end{array}$

故 $\sigma = \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cdot EY_{1}$ ，所以 $\sigma$ 的矩估计量为 $\hat{\sigma} = \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{2}}\overline{Y}$ ，其中 $\overline{Y} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i = 1}^{n}Y_{i} = Y.$

（Ⅲ）记 $Z_{i} = X_{i} - \mu \sim N(0,\sigma^{2})$ ，则 $EZ_{i} = 0, DZ_{i} = \sigma^{2}$ ，故

$E (| X _ {i} - \mu |) = E (| Z _ {i} |) = E Y _ {i} = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma ,$

$\begin{array}{r l} D (| X _ {i} - \mu |) & = D (| Z _ {i} |) = E (| Z _ {i} | ^ {2}) - (E | Z _ {i} |) ^ {2} \\ & = E (Z _ {i} ^ {2}) - \left(\sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma\right) ^ {2} \\ & = D Z _ {i} + (E Z _ {i}) ^ {2} - \left(\sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma\right) ^ {2} \\ & = \sigma^ {2} - \left(\sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma\right) ^ {2} = \left(1 - \frac {2}{\pi}\right) \sigma^ {2}, \end{array}$

所以

$E Y = E \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} | X _ {i} - \mu |\right) = \frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} E (| Z _ {i} |) = E (| Z _ {i} |) = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma .$

又 $X_{1}, X_{2}, \cdots, X_{n}$ 相互独立，故

$D Y = D \left(\frac {1}{n} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} | X _ {i} - \mu |\right) = \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} D Y _ {i} = \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n} \left(1 - \frac {2}{\pi}\right).$

【注】此题的第(Ⅰ)(Ⅱ)问是2017年的考题,事实上这是一个结论:设 $X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}$ 相互独立,且均服从 $N(\mu,\sigma^{2}),Y=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}|X_{i}-\mu|$ ,则

$E Y = \sqrt {\frac {2}{\pi}} \sigma , D Y = \frac {\sigma^ {2}}{n} \left(1 - \frac {2}{\pi}\right).$
